The modifications in both files are related to the same overarching issue of preventing double activation of interrupts. This change is consistent across both the `io_apic.c` and `hpet.c` files, indicating a unified approach to handling interrupt activation in the x86 architecture. The patch aims to ensure that interrupts are properly deactivated before any new configurations are applied, thereby maintaining system stability and preventing potential bugs related to interrupt handling.
